content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I created several User Defined Functions with analog flags, but they appear as inactive and I can't use them. Does anyone know what I might be doing wrong? Is special hardware required or something else?

Hello [user_name], I've already replied to you about this topic in the German forum, but I'd like to share the solution here in English for wider visibility. To resolve this, go to the menu of [product_name] V8 and select 'Tools > Options > UDF'. Add any greyed-out UDFs to the UDF Library, making sure to locate the correct path on your computer where your UDFs are stored. For additional clarification, refer to the screenshot. Hope this helps. Best regards, [user_name]
Hi, I added them all as suggested, but they're still inactive. What can I try next?
Hello, The UDF shown in your screenshot isn't valid—some blocks (B5, B6, and B8) aren't connected to the output. All blocks must be correctly linked for the UDF to work. Regards,
Thanks so much! It's working now.

analysis.insight_summary: Users had trouble making their own User Defined Functions with analog flags active when using [product_name] V8 software. The key issue was that UDFs stayed inactive even after following standard instructions to add them. The problem was clarified: UDFs will remain inactive if any block within them is not properly connected, meaning the function is considered invalid.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that after adding custom UDFs with analog flags to the UDF Library in the software, they can activate and use them successfully.
